name: cerne
description: Living docs for AI-agent projects: feature state, decisions and search as read-only MCP tools.
long_description: cerne keeps a project's living documentation as structured data: which features exist and in which lifecycle state, the decisions (ADRs), notes, runbooks and references, with full-text search over their history. This bundle serves one cerne project to the client over stdio, read-only: no tool writes anything, and nothing is sent anywhere but the client. The project folder must already be a cerne project (`cerne init`); see the repository for installing the CLI.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Feature states and the epics rollup: what exists and in which lifecycle state.

tools.name: brief
tools.description: The whole project roster as id, state and title per entity, no paths.

tools.name: next
tools.description: Active features grouped by their next action, plus the documentation debts lint finds.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find entities and documents by subject (full-text, history included).

tools.name: show
tools.description: Read one entity by id: its metadata and its documents.

tools.name: context
tools.description: The task package: a feature's stage document, its epic and the notes and decisions that inform it, within a token budget.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: The sources that answer a question, ranked, with snippets. Makes no LLM call.

tools.name: guide
tools.description: How to use cerne itself: the matching sections of its skill, command help and FAQ.

project_dir.title: Project folder
project_dir.description: The root of a cerne project (the folder with its .cernerc).
